name: Fear of Boof Prepackaged Flower | NYC Diesel
description: A powerful new hybrid born from the bold union of Fire OG and Super Dope's Cherry Popperz, this strain brings the best of both worlds: the heavy-hitting potency and earthy pine notes of the Fire OG blend seamlessly with the sweet, candy-coated cherry flavor of Cherry Popperz. Flaming Cherries is an exclusive release and quantities are extremely limited.
